subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete sentence.
stimulus: There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Modern technology i. highway-roads and so on. b. Computer based ii. in communication are being conducted c. CC Camera system may be used to trace iii. plays a vital role in this regard. d. Nowadays many things iv. network is called internet. e. On-line Banking system v. out criminals, arrest them and punish them vi. network or internet system. vii. has already been started in some banks.
guide_solution: (a + iii) : Modern technology plays a vital role in this regard. (b + iv) : Computer based network is called internet. (c + v) : CC Camera system may be used to trace out criminals, arrest them and punish them. (d + ii) : Nowadays many things in communication are being conducted (e + vii) : On-line Banking system has already been started in some banks.
